newsitem.title: USA: Quanex completes sale of LaSalle to Niagara.
newsitem.headline: Quanex completes sale of LaSalle to Niagara.

text.p: Quanex Corp said Friday that it had completed the previously announced sale of LaSalle Steel Co to a subsidiary of the Niagara Corp in a stock-for-cash transaction valued at about $65 million.
Quanex said proceeds from the sale will be used to pay down its revolving line of credit and for reinvestment in its higher margin, higher growth businesses.

LaSalle manufactures cold drawn and chrome-plated steel at plants in Hammond and Griffith, Indiana. Niagara is a producer of cold finished steel bars. Quanex is a mini-mill producer of value- added steel bars, aluminum flat-rolled products, seamless and welded steel tubing, and impact-extruded aluminum and steel products.
